request: Build a small Jac web app that writes a one-line commit message for a pasted unified diff. It builds a prompt from the diff, asks the model, and cleans the reply: strips quotes, code fences and a trailing period, maps past-tense first verbs to imperative with a small fixed table, and keeps it within 72 characters. Large diffs are cut per file before prompting.
acceptance: A reply of '"Added login check."' becomes 'Add login check'.
A reply longer than 72 characters is cut at a word boundary to at most 72.
An empty diff returns an error without calling the model; an oversized diff keeps every file's header lines.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Call the model through byLLM (`by llm`); tests use MockLLM with scripted outputs and never call a real model or the network.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
